preregistration.decision_rule: A: beneficial, sign-consistent (>=4/5 seeds) and conventionally large (|Cohen's dz| >= 0.8, p < 0.05) paired SEQUENCE-LEVEL effect at T=10 or T=20, together with net candidate->commit rescue (rescue>regression) and no large operation-level regression. B: the local commit mechanism moves (margin / coordinate delivery) or net rescue is positive, but there is no beneficial sequence-level effect. C: no meaningful benefit (neither margin/coordinate benefit nor sequence benefit). D: harmful sequence-level effect with neither margin nor rescue benefit. Local-only improvement with T10/T20 unchanged classifies as B, not A.
preregistration.note: Intervention on the full 212-dim gate vector only, as a coordinate-preserving monotone remap about 0.5; recursive rollout; no readout/label/decision-margin information enters the intervention. kappa values fixed before results; no random/scramble control is introduced (Experiment J already covered scattering).
